source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-35

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic fluid level check
steps: At operating temperature: start the engine in Park without racing it and move the selector through every range.
Right away, with the selector in Park, engine running and the car on level ground, read the dipstick; it should be at FULL.
Add fluid if needed to reach FULL.

If the car has not been driven 15 expressway miles or the equivalent, check with the fluid at room temperature (70°F): start in Park without racing, run through each range, then read the dipstick in Park with the engine running on level ground; it should read 1/4" below ADD.
notes: Caution: do not overfill; the fluid can foam and blow out the vent pipe as it heats. Running too low, especially cold, can cause total loss of drive and transmission failure.
A level set correctly at 70°F will read FULL once the transmission reaches 180°F.
